decision.observation: Grip released; reticle hollow on a red boulder with black pockmarks ahead. Behind it palms grow at the crest; to the right a sand ramp with green shrubs and a purple spiky plant; pale monoliths left against purple sky. Green stamina good, teal spent segment present.
decision.hypothesis: The boulder is a short wall to skirt. The sand ramp on the right with shrubs looks walkable and rises toward the palm terrace — go around the right flank.
decision.memory: Right-side sand ramp with shrubs and purple spiky plant bypasses this pockmarked boulder toward the palm terrace.
